title: git.metering
description: Per-RPC metering event emitted by the Gitaly hook layer (ADR-015 reconciliation tier). Written to git.git_outbox by the TwoTierCounter after a successful ReceivePack/UploadPack/InfoRefs; drained by the existing outbox consumer to TopicGitMeteringEvents and applied to the analytics sink (ClickHouse). Idempotent on event_id.

event_id.description: Idempotency key. Aggregates with the same event_id MUST be treated as one event by the analytics sink.

agent_id.description: Empty string for non-agent (human) operations; UUID-like otherwise. Drives per-agent enforcement keys.

pack_objects.description: Object count from the Gitaly pack-objects hook. Zero on info_refs and upload_pack until the Gitaly custom hook lands (Phase 3).

ref_updates.description: Number of refs touched by the operation. Always 0 on fetch and info_refs.
